title.value: Evaluating Digital Tools for Sustainable Agriculture using Causal Inference
title.justification: The title clearly states that the paper focuses on the evaluation of digital tools tailored for sustainable agriculture using causal inference methodologies.
title.quote: Evaluating Digital Tools for Sustainable Agriculture using Causal Inference

extractions.description: The paper examines the impact of digital tools on sustainable agriculture by employing causal inference. It highlights the limitations of current adoption rates of AI-driven farming technologies and the necessity of providing empirical, quantitative evidence of their benefits to farmers. An observational causal inference framework is proposed for assessing farm performance enhancements through digital recommendations, specifically examining a recommendation system for cotton sowing.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: Sustainable agriculture is directly addressed as the main focus, aiming to improve productivity and resilience against climate changes using digital technology.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: ...to increase productivity and secure a sustainable and resilient agriculture against a changing climate.

primary_category.justification: The emphasis is on adapting agricultural practices to make them more sustainable and resilient to climate change using data-driven decision support systems.
primary_category.quote: ...accelerate the adoption of technologies that aim to increase productivity and secure a sustainable and resilient agriculture against a changing climate.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper also touches on improving the efficiency and effectiveness of cotton sowing, which can contribute to reducing emissions indirectly by optimizing resource use.
secondary_categories.quote: ...optimize crop management with zero waste, enhance resilience, increase production and reduce emissions [41].

primary_sub_category.justification: The proposed framework is intended to provide farmers with AI-based recommendations to optimize their agricultural practices, specifically focusing on cotton sowing to increase yield, thus supporting them through enhanced decision-making.
primary_sub_category.quote: ...we evaluate a recommendation system for the optimal sowing of cotton, given sowing time is of great importance for arable crops.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: While focusing on the empirical evaluation for the farmers, the paper also discusses broader implications for agriculture through digital tool assessments.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: ...empirical evaluation of the impact of digital tools on target farm performance indicators.

applications.value: Causal inference framework for evaluating digital agriculture tools
applications.justification: The application discussed is creating a causal inference framework that can be employed to evaluate digital agriculture tools, specifically evident in the case study on cotton sowing.
applications.quote: ...an observational causal inference framework for the empirical evaluation of the impact of digital tools on target farm performance indicators.

applications.value: Recommendation system for optimal cotton sowing
applications.justification: The paper specifically evaluates a recommendation system developed to advise farmers on optimal sowing times for cotton to increase yields and adapt to climate challenges.
applications.quote: ...a recommendation system for the optimal sowing of cotton, which was used by a farmers’ cooperative during the growing season of 2021.

new_primary_category.justification: The existing categories adequately describe the focus and contents of the paper.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The existing sub-categories sufficiently cover the themes addressed in the paper.
